import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime for analysis
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Total Sales by Product (Top Left)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors1 = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(product_sales))
axes[0, 0].barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors1)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(product_sales.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v + 50, i, f'${v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group and Size (Top Right)
age_size_sales = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'size'])['total'].sum().unstack()
# Reorder age groups logically
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_size_sales = age_size_sales.reindex([a for a in age_order if a in age_size_sales.index])
age_size_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 1], colormap='Set2', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales by Age Group and Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Size', loc='upper right')
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution (Bottom Left)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors3 = sns.color_palette('pastel')
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[1, 0].pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                           autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors3,
                                           explode=[0.02]*len(payment_counts), startangle=90)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Average Transaction Value by Product and Takeaway Status (Bottom Right)
df['takeaway_label'] = df['is_takeaway'].map({1: 'Takeaway', 0: 'Dine-in'})
avg_transaction = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='product', columns='takeaway_label', aggfunc='mean')
avg_transaction.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 1], colormap='coolwarm', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Avg Transaction by Product & Takeaway Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Order Type', loc='upper right')
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
